passage: Please hold off on brushing dust off the loose letters on these signs. Dust is useful here: it shows where each letter rested. Take a picture before you remove it. I’ve already photographed the green sign, so that one can go ahead. Lay its loose letters on a tray in the order they came off. A photograph shows the positions on the sign, but it won’t tell us which of two almost identical letters came from a particular slot. If the job goes to another bench, send the sign and the tray together, with the letters still in order.
